summary: Marketing is pivoting to SEO-led growth for Asia Star and Intelligent China while redesigning the knowledge website, with urgent contract and speaker confirmations needed this week.
summaryDetail: The most pressing matter is finalizing the speaker for the Sept 15 Tech in Asia luncheon—Dean Xiang is confirmed but needs a formal follow-up, and if unavailable, Prof. Chen must be locked in today. Simultaneously, the contract for Gontran's invoice needs to be filled and sent to Ben for PO approval, while the brand video requires consolidated feedback for re-cutting. On the strategic front, SEO efforts are now focused on Asia Star and Intelligent China, with a decision to split Intelligent China's webpage into separate module pages; the team is analyzing existing leads to define target audiences and awaiting a conversion tracking brief. The knowledge website redesign is in review, with feedback due on two versions, and the alternative design's HTML file to be shared. Additionally, the Outlook account lockout issue is resolved but requires user action to re-login on all devices, and there is an upcoming follow-up on the China Going-Global report and Asia Start initiatives.
